message:
fix(standby): the lease keeps its endpoint after a session -- tied to its own target, no dissolve (keepalive-r2 2 e)

AVD ke_r4: after 16a1817 the socket survived, but the second activation still went unanswered: connect(AF_UNSPEC) on
Linux also gives up an automatically bound port, so the lease came back on ANOTHER endpoint, which its relay lease does
not know (the relay drops a StandbyActivate from an unknown endpoint). Windows cannot un-connect a UDP socket at all.

So nothing is dissolved: after a session the socket stays tied to the session's peer -- the lease's own target (its
Pings, an activation and a release go there) -- on the SAME endpoint. Before it aims anywhere else (an observation for
a new capability, which is a new lease at the relay anyway) the lease opens a fresh socket (ObserveFrom).

standby_lease_test 57/57 (x3); mutants (a tied socket not noted; not marked shared) FAIL. e2e 74/74.
